topic.name: Bosch iconography
topic.scope: Static and animated icons used to communicate the Bosch brand and support user experience across touchpoints.

core_guidance.summary: Icons are essential for communicating our brand in all areas. Both static and animated, they help convey information and enhance the user experience.

principles.principle: Use icons as essential brand communication elements
principles.meaning_for_ai: Treat icons as part of Bosch brand expression, not merely decorative UI elements.
principles.evidence: The page states that icons are essential for communicating the brand in all areas.

principles.principle: Support information transfer and UX clarity
principles.meaning_for_ai: Select or generate icons to clarify meaning, improve orientation, and reduce cognitive load for users.
principles.evidence: The page states that static and animated icons help convey information and enhance user experience.

principles.principle: Differentiate static and animated icon applications
principles.meaning_for_ai: When creating or selecting assets, distinguish between static icon use cases and animated icon use cases instead of treating them as one asset type.
principles.evidence: The topic overview separates Icons and Animated icons as two linked sections.

visual_style_inferred_from_page_assets.asset_preview_format: PNG previews in a square 1600 x 1600 presentation format
visual_style_inferred_from_page_assets.limitations: The HTML contains preview assets and high-level guidance, but detailed icon construction rules, stroke width, grid, corner radius, or animation timing are not exposed in the captured page text.

recommended_ai_fields_for_future_icon_ge.semantic_intent: The user meaning the icon should communicate
recommended_ai_fields_for_future_icon_ge.context_of_use: UI, presentation, campaign, product communication, documentation, etc.

ai_readability_notes.how_to_use_this_json: Use this file as a compact research summary of the Bosch Brand Guide iconography page. It is intended to inform AI prompts, design-system documentation, and asset-selection decisions.
do_not_overinfer: Do not assume exact Bosch icon grid, stroke width, or animation timing from this page alone.
Do not recreate proprietary icon assets directly unless the user has permission and provides the needed source assets.
Do not treat the preview PNGs as complete production specifications.
ai_readability_notes.safe_generation_direction: Generate icon concepts that are simple, functional, brand-aligned, and optimized for clarity; validate final assets against the official Bosch icon library before production use.
